notes.title: Update v.1.2.2
notes.notes: [list][*][p]The Deer now uses an idle animation (on one's feet.) when it is in freeze mode, making it easier to spot him.[/p][/*][*][p]Reduced the Deer’s damage from 55 to 40 so players with less than full HP can react after being hit.[/p][/*][*][p]For the first 3 days on free maps, the weather will always be Good, making it easier for newcomers to meet the first quota and get familiar with the game.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug with trees on Old Castle[/p][/*][*][p]You now get 6 cooked eggs or 3 packs of nuggets from a bird egg.[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Update v.1.2.1
notes.notes: [p][/p][list][*][p]Fixed AI navigation issues[/p][/*][*][p]Corrected some translation errors[/p][/*][*][p]Improved collision on the white cabinet[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed wrong shadows on the terrain[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Update v.1.2.0
notes.notes: [list][*][p]You can now restart the game immediately without needing to recreate the lobby. (Host Button Only)[/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45490594/f919cfa946f334722e5f73f9ca7483ff5c2811cf.png"][/img][/p][list][*][p]Burning barrels now provide warmth 10 times faster![/p][/*][*][p]Killed or angry aliens will now displayed as "ERROR" on the Radar Map.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45490594/e67caba2aeab53aedbd72bd16dd92056963096b9.png"][/img][/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Killed aliens now drop money (half of the normal payout).[/p][p]Please don’t try to kill them after delivery — it doesn’t make any sense.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45490594/d7a0caba403f5724f0dfdcf38bedc44fbcf4519d.png"][/img][/p][/*][*][p]Calories are now tracked not only in the food alien menu, but also for you and the fridge.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45490594/ab5fa653e903702ffd95c79b6cd8dfa9304e1738.png"][/img][/p][/*][*][p]The quota multiplier has been reworked — it no longer increases abruptly. Instead, the growth percentage gradually decreases over time. Now there are no impossible quotas, and everything should feel fair. Stock up on food and aim for a new record!  [/p][p]The quota multiplier will decrease down to 1.2 and then stay fixed at that value. Here’s how it looks: 2.1 1.95 1.8 1.7 1.6 1.5 1.4 1.3 1.2....[/p][p][/p][p][b][u]Since the game doesn't have version checking, it's recommended to avoid joining public lobbies — at least for the first few hours :) — until everyone has updated. [/u][/b][/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Update v.1.1.6
notes.notes: [list][*][p]Reworked water rising behavior for the "Flood" and "Hell" weather situation. The water now rises slightly slower and can no longer rise above your bunker doors, giving you a fair chance to run in and out without being completely submerged.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where the quick right-hand interaction animation would not play.[/p][/*][*][p]Removed the "No Signal" overlay from dead players' cameras, as it often behaved incorrectly and could flicker.[/p][/*][*][p]Various minor game and balance adjustments.[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Update v.1.1.5
notes.notes: [list][*][p]Major steps toward optimization[/p][/*][*][p]Reworked overall sound volume and balanced walkie-talkie volume[/p][/*][*][p]Medkits now restore more health[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Update v.1.1.0
notes.notes: [list][*][p]Increased damage of the knife and shovel[/p][/*][*][p]Increased the angle you need to look at for the Deer to freeze[/p][/*][*][p]After Swampy deals damage, he will return to Mode 1, giving you a chance to break the sprint[/p][/*][*][p]Train ride reworked to reduce lag during world generation[/p][/*][*][p]Improved NetCode in some areas to reduce CPU usage[/p][/*][*][p]Server region window has been moved to the center[/p][/*][*][p]Dropped items no longer fly away as far[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where the tunnel SEED didn't match during generation[/p][/*][*][p]Other minor tweaks and fixes[/p][p]! notes.title: Release Date & Time
notes.notes:
[p]Hey Couriers! 

I've got some big news to share with you! On [b]Tuesday, July 29th[/b], delivery pals will be fully released at [b]10am CST | 8am PST | 5pm CEST | 11am EST [/b]and there will be a 10% launch discount. [/p][p][/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="MG2zxJw4Cek;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][p]Here's what you can expect: [/p][list][*][p]Exploring different maps and scavenging for goods[/p][/*][*][p]Play with up to six friends[/p][/*][*][p]Character customizations with different hats and glasses [/p][/*][*][p]Cooking food inside your train base[/p][/*][*][p]Delivering orders to aliens and earning money[/p][/*][*][p]Buying items from the shop with the money you earn or putting your earnings into the ATM for the overall quota during the round[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]Each round will have a different quota amount for you and your friends to fulfill, and customers will vary on the amount of calories you will need to bring them. I hope you will all enjoy the game![/p][p][/p][p]As we get closer to the launch, it would mean a lot if you could drop me a wishlist as it will help a lot with visibility. [/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3237570/delivery_pals/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p]Thank you so much for your support, and I will see you all on Tuesday in the game![/p][p][/p][p]Best Regards,[/p][p]stre1itzia
[/p]
